build_PatchEmbed: build a PatchEmbed module to convert 2D images into patch embeddings for a vision transformer
create_make_2tuple: create a function that converts an int or tuple into a 2-tuple for image or patch size
test_PatchEmbed_forward: test the PatchEmbed forward pass by passing a tensor and verifying output shape
review_PatchEmbed_flops: review the PatchEmbed flops method to calculate FLOPs for the convolution and normalization layers
refactor_PatchEmbed_norm: refactor the PatchEmbed class to use a custom normalization layer instead of Identity
